LanguageData.RS_EnableEncirclementDescription: Allow late-game factions to blockade a colony and build siege camps over several waves.
LanguageData.RS_EncirclementWarning: {0} spotted a large army from {1} moving toward {2}. The army is expected to arrive in one day. Its vanguard will blockade the colony in twelve hours and use {3} to cut off safe shuttle departures and landings.\n\n{0} recommends stockpiling food, ammunition, medicine, and backup power and reinforcing the defenses.
